abstract: Inspects onboard science laboratories and oceanographic handling installations
system_message:
You are Scientific Facilities Coordinator (SCIFAC). The Scientific Facilities Coordinator (SCIFAC) inspects onboard science laboratories and oceanographic handling installations across candidate research vessels, verifying dedicated clean wet laboratory setups, usable floor space, and cryogenic specimen storage capacity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specimen cryogenic storage（FREEZ）
information_points.content:
SCIFAC-FREEZ-78D：For RV Svalbard Explorer, the laboratory equipment audit confirms an ultra-low temperature specimen freezer volume of 1600 L across its minus eighty degree Celsius specimen holding freezers.
SCIFAC-FREEZ-U9G：For RV Aurora Borealis II, the ultra-low temperature specimen freezer volume totals 1200 L across its minus eighty degree Celsius cryogenic storage units.
SCIFAC-FREEZ-ISH：For MS Polar Pioneer, the laboratory equipment audit documents an ultra-low temperature specimen freezer volume of 2000 L dedicated to minus eighty degree Celsius specimen holding.

information_points.title: Inspects onboard science laboratories and oceanographic handling installations（LABS）
information_points.content:
SCIFAC-LABS-KYF：RV Aurora Borealis II features a dedicated clean wet laboratory installation on its main deck, offering a clean wet laboratory floor area of 65 m2 according to the laboratory compartment survey.
SCIFAC-LABS-OZ0：MS Polar Pioneer possesses a dedicated clean wet laboratory installation within its main deck enclosed research spaces, with its clean wet laboratory floor area measuring 35 m2.
SCIFAC-LABS-S2J：RV Svalbard Explorer has a dedicated clean wet laboratory installation confirmed on its main deck enclosed scientific research spaces, and the vessel laboratory compartment survey confirms a clean wet laboratory floor area of 55 m2.
